name: @linknms/services
description: Retained R0 backend services after the v2 cutover (LINA-400 Phase 12c): Identity (the live seat gate + email→party bridge), Email, Auth, Waitlist, plus the pure Ledger utilities (pg pool + hash-chain trust anchor) the identity module still imports. Decision, Change Order, Schedule, the Ledger audit machinery and Analytics were pruned with the v1 service graph and their schemas dropped (services/waitlist/migrations/0004). One Postgres schema per service (ADR-0006).
